items.html: And when the sparks of holiness were sorted out in the secret of the thirty-two Elohim, as mentioned, the rest of the sparks descended below. And these remaining sparks are the secret of the Malchut in each of the first thirty-two paths, for Elohim is the secret of MI ELEH: MI is the secret of GAR, included within Bina, and ELEH is the secret of VAK. For the GAR and the VAK in each and every path of the first ones of the judgments were sorted to the side of holiness; however, the Malchut in each and every path of the first ones became waste below, since it is last in every path, and could not be sorted. And this is "and the earth was without form and void," for it is the earth in each and every path.
